title: Deadline and Border
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Ada Eastwick, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
